products.name: Desmos
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI features: none recorded. Use: Graphing calculators and classroom activities. Who: Teachers, students. Student age: Anyone can use calculators without an account; classroom accounts free. Privacy: No signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement listed in one K-12 directory. Price: Calculators free; Amplify Classroom (formerly Desmos Classroom) free; Amplify Desmos Math curriculum paid.

reading.body:
Desmos is catalogued as an education AI product with no AI features recorded, which makes its category label the most questionable fact in the entry.

The product itself is a set of free math tools: graphing, scientific, geometry, and 3D calculators, plus Notebook and classroom activities, used by teachers and students. Anyone can use the calculators without an account, and classroom accounts are free. Revenue sits elsewhere, in the paid Amplify Desmos Math curriculum. The only compliance signal recorded is negative: one K-12 directory does not list a signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement.

For AI specifically, the entry says nothing about compute, buildings, or power, and it would be wrong to infer any. A graphing calculator runs on the device in a student's hand. The absence of recorded AI features is the substantive finding, not a gap to be filled by assumption.

What the data does not cover is large. It does not say whether AI features exist but went unrecorded, which directory was checked, or what the privacy agreement's absence means in practice. It records one product for a company whose name pairs a studio with Amplify, and it does not explain that relationship. Treat the category as an index label rather than a description of the software.

profile_text.body:
Desmos Studio builds free math tools, including Graphing, Scientific, Geometry, and 3D Calculators along with Notebook, according to its website. The site describes the math as "beautiful" and free, and invites visitors to explore the tools, partner with the company, or browse examples for inspiration.

The company's tracked product is Desmos, listed under Education and Research AI. No AI features are recorded for it. Its graphing calculators and classroom activities are used by teachers and students, and anyone can use the calculators without an account, with classroom accounts free. Calculators are free, Amplify Classroom (formerly Desmos Classroom) is free, and the Amplify Desmos Math curriculum is paid. One K-12 directory does not list a signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement for the product.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
